label: Возвращаясь
description: A 10-sentence card for возвращаясь, the imperfective gerund of возвращаться.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Reflexive front position. Возвращаясь comes from the reflexive возвращаться (возвраща-ются) plus the reflexive gerund ending -ясь. The fronted gerund names what she did on the way home.

missions.phrase: Он звонил жене, возвращаясь с работы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: End position. Here возвращаясь closes the sentence and runs parallel to звонил. Both actions belong to the subject он and happen at the same time.

missions.phrase: Возвращаясь поздно, ты будишь всю семью.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Reflexive ending -ясь. Reflexive verbs keep their marker in the gerund as -ясь. Возвращаясь runs simultaneously with the present main verb будишь — returning late, you wake everyone.

missions.phrase: Возвращаясь из школы, дети заходят в магазин.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Same-subject rule. The ones who return in возвращаясь must be the ones who stop at the shop — a single subject дети. A reflexive gerund still cannot introduce a separate doer.
Strategic focus: Future main clause. The main clause is future (увидим), but возвращаясь stays unchanged — gerunds have no future form. Returning in the evening, we will see the sunset.
Strategic focus: Plural subject. Even with the plural subject туристы, the reflexive form stays возвращаясь — gerunds are indeclinable and take no number ending, unlike the participle возвращающиеся.

missions.phrase: Возвращаясь домой, он думал о встрече.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past main clause. The finite verb думал is past, yet возвращаясь marks concurrency: while returning home, he thought about the meeting. The imperfective gerund signals overlap, not sequence.

missions.phrase: Возвращаясь в город, я всегда волнуюсь.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Present habitual. The main verb волнуюсь is a regular present, and возвращаясь gives the accompanying circumstance: returning to the city, I always feel anxious. Both verbs share the subject я.

missions.phrase: Возвращаясь со станции, бабушка несла сумку.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Indeclinable form. With the feminine subject бабушка the gerund stays возвращаясь, taking no gender or case ending. The participle возвращающаяся would inflect; the gerund holds one fixed shape.

Strategic focus: Two parallel actions. Друзья is the shared subject of both разговаривали and возвращаясь, the actions overlapping in time. The reflexive gerund folds while they returned into one indeclinable word.
